where: hir_def::deps::serve::withdraw_moved and test fixtures with two crates in one source root
what: A hegel test failed with 'an edit of `main` took `lib`'s pages away' and read as a defect of the per-crate slot split. It was the fixture: both crates were in one source root, and a write of any file of a source root withdraws every served crate of that root (the grain of the image key).
cost: about 25k tokens of reading (slots, maintainers, implied writes) before the fixture
cause: the withdrawal's grain (source root) is said only in `withdraw_moved`'s doc; the shared fixture has no `new_source_root`, unlike deps/tests.rs's
class: a test fixture whose layout differs from the layout the rule under test is keyed by
prevention: the test now builds its fixture with lib in a root of its own and has a control that states the one-root behaviour; not built: withdrawal by the crate's own key or file list rather than by root (design note in /tmp/fix-hirdef/next.md)
workaround: `new_source_root:local` on the dependency's root file in the fixture
